correctness.rationale: Checked exact follower-block decomposition of the combinatorial full Laplacian after a clique and k-a independent-set leaders: clique residual has 2n eigenvalue on zero-sum subspace, independent residual has n eigenvalue; the 2x2 constant-space Schur block yields objective (n-a-1)/(2n)+(n-k+a-1)/n+(2n+a)/(nk+a(n-k+a)). For k/sqrt(n)→c and a/sqrt(n)→s, subtracting a-independent leading terms leaves limiting strictly convex s/2+2/(c+s) on 0<=s<=c, whose minimizer s=min(c,max(0,2-c)). Uniform finite-ratio/derivative control supports endpoint exactness outside 1<c<2, with finite integer ties covered by the limiting statement. Exact fractions independently recomputed all a for n=20,k=4 and 7, verifying unique a=4 with cost 8/5 and a=0 with cost 381/280; also examined pinned script enumerating 502 direct matrix inversions. All-order result is analytic, not just a numerical sample.

value.rationale: Exact optimal leader allocation on a naturally heterogeneous yet highly symmetric split core–periphery graph is a meaningful structural classification, with a nontrivial budget-dependent migration and an explicit failure of nested optimal sets. The sqrt-scale parameter transition specifies where the expensive clique infrastructure ceases to be optimal; it is not a cosmetic renaming of a biclique theorem.
